messages.text:
Listem what is the point of ignoring me like this?

you convinced me that you don’t want me in your life anymore and i’ve largely left you alone
Can you at LEAST just say that you’re doing this because you’re seeing someone else?

Because you just deciding one day out of nowhere to suddenly hate me and never speak to me or see me without any reason why is not good. I can’t make sense of what the hell happened or why and just….at least if you said you started hating me and cut me out because you were with someone else it would make sense
